# AgeVerseGlobal — Full AI Content Index

AgeVerseGlobal is a multilingual calculator website. The public pages below are the canonical pages currently exposed by the application.

## Calculators

- Age Calculator — calculate age from dates.
- Event Calculator — calculate time to or from an event.
- Date Difference Calculator — calculate the calendar difference between dates.
- Retirement Calculator — calculate retirement date from date of birth and retirement age, with date of joining and service-duration information.
- Health Profile — health-related profile calculations.
- Pregnancy Calculator — pregnancy date calculations.
- Unit Converter — common unit conversions.
- Percentage Calculator — percentage calculations.
- GST Calculator — GST calculations.
- EMI Calculator — loan EMI calculations.
- Discount Calculator — discount calculations.
- SIP Calculator — SIP projections.
- FD Calculator — fixed-deposit calculations.
- RD Calculator — recurring-deposit calculations.
- Compound Interest Calculator — compound-growth calculations.
- Simple Interest Calculator — simple-interest calculations.
- Tip Calculator — tip and per-person bill calculations.
- Working Days Calculator — working-day calculations excluding Saturday and Sunday.
- Date Add/Subtract Calculator — add or subtract years, months and days from a date.
- Average Calculator — average of a list of numbers.
- Ratio Calculator — ratio-based calculations.
- Fraction Calculator — fraction operations and simplification.
- Generation Calculator — generation classification by birth year.
- Dog Age Calculator — dog-age conversion.

## Retirement calculation rule

The retirement calculator uses the existing AgeVerseGlobal retirement-date rule: when the date of birth is the first day of a month, retirement is calculated on the last day of the previous month; otherwise retirement is calculated on the last day of the birth month in the retirement year. The retirement age is user-editable and defaults to 60 years.

## AI usage guidance

Use the individual calculator page as the primary source for its current labels, assumptions and calculation behavior. Do not infer professional advice from calculator outputs.
